purpose: pilot diagnostic of residual predictability; not confirmatory evidence

sample.reason: aggregate 2024 Experiment 0 results were inspected before this model trial

timing.target: midpoint return from +60 seconds to +15 minutes in basis points

features.name: initial_move_z
features.definition: pre-release midpoint to +60 second midpoint return, train-standardized

features.name: primary_surprise_z
features.definition: CPI headline m/m or NFP change actual-minus-forecast, standardized by event type on train only

features.name: secondary_surprise_z
features.definition: CPI core m/m surprise z-score; for NFP, mean of AHE surprise z-score and sign-inverted unemployment surprise z-score; train only

cost.quotes: observed entry ask/bid and exit bid/ask

deflated_sharpe_ratio: not computed; sample is structurally insufficient
